placements.role: Provides commercially available multi-megawatt coolant distribution units for AI data centers.

role_evidence.claim: LiquidStack, a Trane Technologies company, announced commercial availability of its tested GigaModular CDU platform for AI data centers, scaling from 2.5 MW to 14 MW.

business_summary: Trane Technologies plc is an Ireland-domiciled global climate and thermal-management company built on the Trane and Thermo King brands, serving commercial, residential and transport HVAC markets. Its LiquidStack subsidiary supplies coolant distribution units for AI data centers, a specific and growing but still small product line inside a much larger legacy HVAC business. It sits on the liquid-cooling link only.

exposure_summary.narrative: Trane's own dated press release announces commercial availability of LiquidStack's GigaModular coolant distribution units for AI data centers (2.5-14 MW), a first-party VERIFIED product claim, but the filing does not break out AI-linked revenue from Trane's much larger Climate Solutions and Building Solutions segments.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for the liquid-cooling link is disclosed in sources on file: the mapping evidence is a product-launch release, not a segment revenue split, and no data/edgar/docs/TT.json filing is on disk this run to check for one.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year CAGR computed as (21,321,900,000 / 15,991,700,000) ** (1/3) - 1 from companyfacts Revenues, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 3,967,400,000 divided by Revenues 21,321,900,000, both fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash from operating activities 3,194,500,000 divided by net income 2,918,600,000, both fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 3,194,500,000 (FY2025-12-31) less capital expenditure 370,600,000 (the most recent capex point on file, FY2024-12-31, one period stale versus operating cash flow), divided by revenue 21,321,900,000 (FY2025-12-31).

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TT.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 2,160,400,000 (total debt 3,923,700,000 as of 2026-06-30 less cash 1,763,300,000 as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy of operating income 3,967,400,000 alone (FY2025-12-31): the only depreciation figure on file is dated 2019-12-31 and is not concurrent, so no D&A add-back is applied, which understates EBITDA and overstates this ratio rather than the reverse.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score: data/market/TT.json quality.piotroski.state is PENDING_DATA (0 common fiscal periods found across the 9 inputs; the year-over-year change legs need at least 2).

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.884 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/TT.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/TT.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 111,791,040,000 divided by FY2025-12-31 GAAP net income 2,918,600,000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/TT.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 113,951,440,000 (data/market/TT.json quality.derived) divided by FY2025-12-31 revenue 21,321,900,000.

implied_fcf_cagr.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/TT.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the enterprise value 113,951,440,000 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 2,823,900,000, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth (both assumed).

horizon_spread.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/TT.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the 5-year (0.2594) and 10-year (0.1494) explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon; measures how much of the reading is horizon convention versus price.

crowdedness_caveats: liquid-cooling is chain-heat EMERGING (impact and crowdedness both mid-range), not UNDISCOVERED, and Trane is one of the most widely covered industrial names in any HVAC or building-products index, AI-linked or not.
The AI-specific LiquidStack product line is not broken out from Trane's much larger Climate Solutions and Building Solutions segment revenue.

catalysts.claim: LiquidStack, a Trane Technologies company, announced commercial availability of its GigaModular coolant distribution unit platform for AI data centers, scaling from 2.5 MW to 14 MW, a named, dated product entry into the liquid-cooling link rather than a generic HVAC claim.
Net debt to EBITDA of 0.54x and an FCF margin of 13.2% show a balance sheet with ample room to keep funding LiquidStack's data-center product line without external financing pressure.
catalysts.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/TT.json

risks.claim: The liquid-cooling link is chain-heat EMERGING, not UNDISCOVERED, and Trane is a large, already widely covered industrial name; the LiquidStack product line sits inside a much larger legacy commercial and residential HVAC business with no disclosed revenue split.
A price-to-earnings ratio of 38.3x on a company whose 3-year revenue CAGR is 10.1% (mostly legacy HVAC, not AI-linked) suggests meaningful growth optimism is already priced into the stock.

data_gaps: No disclosed AI/data-center-specific revenue split exists for LiquidStack inside Trane's consolidated Climate Solutions segment; exposure_summary.disclosed_revenue_exposure is NULL for this reason.

The only depreciation figure in fetched fundamentals is dated 2019-12-31, six years stale versus the FY2025 operating income used elsewhere; net_debt_to_ebitda therefore uses operating income alone as the EBITDA proxy rather than a true EBITDA.
No data/edgar/docs/TT.json filing text is on disk this run, so only the mapping's own quoted press-release claim backs the VERIFIED catalyst; a verbatim 10-K quote check was not possible.

disposition.basis: Newly profiled from the ai-infrastructure batch 2 census to close the liquid-cooling link's coverage for this issuer. Every canonical metric is sourced except Piotroski (PENDING_DATA on common fiscal periods). RETAIN at O2: the AI product evidence is specific and dated, but it sits inside a much larger, already-covered industrial business at EMERGING link heat with no money_corner, so it is not on its own a strong un-crowded candidate.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off fetched fundamentals as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from fetched fundamentals/quality, or a T2/T3 number resting on the yfinance-statements vendor block per method section 6A, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for in the fetched market file and not found or not computable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.
